trust_decision.summary: Whether a submitted login/email plus password authenticates is decided in UsersManager.logUser (bcrypt compare against the stored hash, then app passwords for scoped auth); every rejection path before it must spend equal bcrypt work and give the same answer so account existence/state is not revealed. Each AuthProvider (MySQL, LDAP, OIDC) looks the user up and returns early without bcrypt when the user is missing or not allowed local auth.

landing_point.why: POST /api/auth/login goes through AuthLocalStrategy (backend/src/authentication/guards/auth-local.strategy.ts:21) to the default MySQL provider, whose not-found branch returns null without any bcrypt work.
